source.projection: equirectangular; RA 0h at center; RA increases leftward; north at top
source.layers: diffuse Milky Way; bright Hipparcos/Tycho foreground omitted

prepared.tonemap: per-channel Reinhard x/(1+x), fixed exposure 1.0, then IEC sRGB transfer, nearest-integer quantization
prepared.orientation: unchanged from source; no flip, crop or resampling
prepared.fidelity: SDR lossy derivative; original HDR fidelity is not retained

credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC; visualization: Ernie Wright

usage_review.determination: SVS permits use and redistribution unless an item states otherwise. No separate copyright restriction was identified for this diffuse map. Preserve NASA and Gaia credits. No NASA logos, people, constellation figures or audio are bundled; do not imply endorsement. This dataset is separate from GlobeCraft code licensing.

runtime: Bundled, offline; one bounded background decode. No runtime download, EXR decode, survey tile cache or GPU sky texture.
transform: sofars 0.6.1 IAU 2006/2000A celestial-to-terrestrial matrix transposed; TT from UTC leap table, UT1 approximated by UTC, polar motion zero. See sofars-LICENSE.txt.
